description: Layout seam for the codex-zenodo acquisition server. The Zenodo record ID or DOI is the primary key; layout is fluid and re-pointable without touching code. 'staging_root' is relative to the repo root unless absolute.

placeholders.{slug}: the 'slug' template below, expanded then sanitized (e.g. zenodo_1234567)

_notes: Metadata is named '{slug}.zenodo.json' (NOT '{slug}.json') so staged files do not trip raw-IR discovery before conversion.
Files downloaded from Zenodo are verified against the record's native md5 checksum.
